lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is widest at the posterior torso and becomes progressively narrower and more irregular towards the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped topological split is visible in the dorsal-mid-torso region where the fourth primary line from the posterior splits into two separate vertical branches.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three abbreviated line segments are visible in the anterior torso/shoulder region that terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior flank and hind limb region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a lateral outward flare from the base, transitioning into a medial-superior curve with a terminal vertical vector.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal fringe/mane extending from the neck to the rump; single white spot on the lower cheek; contrasting tan-colored lower leg extremities below the carpal/tarsal joints.
